title.zh: 将东明多洛省 Roxas 市镇 Roxas 区医院床位由五十（50）张增至一百（100）张并为其拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Roxas District Hospital in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Oriental Mindoro From Fifty (50) to One Hundred (100) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Roxas District Hospital in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Oriental Mindoro From Fifty (50) to One Hundred (100) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Huyện Roxas tại Đô thị Roxas, Tỉnh Oriental Mindoro từ 50 lên 100 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Roxas ในเทศบาล Roxas จังหวัด Oriental Mindoro จาก 50 เป็น 100 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Distrik Roxas di Kotamadya Roxas, Provinsi Oriental Mindoro dari 50 menjadi 100 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Daerah Roxas di Perbandaran Roxas, Wilayah Oriental Mindoro daripada 50 kepada 100 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11869_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Roxas District Hospital in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Oriental Mindoro is hereby increased from fifty (50) to one hundred (100) bed. Any future increase in bed capacity shall be consistent with the hospital development plan that shall be prepared by the Chief of Hospital of the RDH, and submitted to the Department of Health (DOH).
The existing professional health care services and facilities of the RDH shall also hereby upgraded to conform with and be commensurate to the bed capacity increase as provided in Section 1 hereof.
The existing workforce of the RDH, which includes doctors, nurses and support personnel, shall also be increased correspondingly.

The Provincial Government of Oriental Mindoro shall provide the necessary funds to cover the maintenance and other operating expenses of the RDH. It shall also appropriate funds for the human resource complement to support the increase in bed capacity and the corresponding upgrading of its service facilities and professional health care services.
The Secretary of the DOH shall include in the Department’s subsidy program, support for the capital outlay requirements of the RDH.
If any provision or part of this Act is declared unconstitutional, the remaining parts or provisions not affected shall remain in full force and effect.
All laws, executive orders, issuances, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
